title: Jarring Mediterranean Hazelnut Tagine
description: A fragrant herbaceous tagine that blends toasted hazelnuts and a hint of Nutella for a sweet-savory midnight snack. This sattvic-friendly dish simmers over gentle heat, delivering a comforting burst of Mediterranean flavors.

ingredients.name: Hazelnuts
ingredients.notes: toasted in dry skillet until fragrant

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet or tagine over medium heat.
Add the diced red onion and cook until translucent, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add 1 teaspoon ground cumin, 1 teaspoon ground coriander, and 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika, cooking for 1 minute to release their aromas.
Mix in 2 tablespoons tomato paste, coating the vegetables, and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the 400‑gram can of diced tomatoes, bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, and let it thicken for 10 minutes.

Stir in 1 cup cooked chickpeas, 1/2 cup toasted hazelnuts, and 2 tablespoons Nutella, allowing the Nutella to melt and blend into the sauce while simmering for another 5 minutes (nimono-simmer technique).
Finish with 2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice, season with salt and pepper to taste, and stir well.
Serve hot, garnishing with extra toasted hazelnuts if desired.
